Senior AI Engineer with 6+ years of experience

Overview

We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer / AI Developer with strong hands-on experience in Python and Azure AI Services to build and enhance an AI-driven compliance platform supporting investment and tax-related workflows. The role focuses on designing and developing AI-powered solutions that ingest, classify, extract, standardize, and process client data through orchestrated workflows. This is an individual contributor role requiring strong coding, problem-solving, and solution delivery skills within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement AI-powered compliance solutions using Python and Azure services.
  • Build data ingestion and transformation pipelines to process client information.
  • Develop workflows to classify, extract, standardize, and enrich data using Azure AI services.
  • Implement and maintain Azure Functions for event-driven and serverless processing.
  • Integrate AI services and business workflows with downstream compliance systems.
  • Map client data to standardized internal schemas and data models.
  • Develop REST APIs, microservices, and workflow orchestrations to support end-to-end processing.
  • Ensure high-quality code through testing, debugging, optimization, and code reviews.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including architects, AI engineers, and business stakeholders.
  • Support integration of processed information into tax data warehouses and compliance platforms.

Must Have Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on Python development experience.
  • Strong experience building scalable backend applications, APIs, and services using Python.
  • Experience with:
    • Azure OpenAI
    • Azure AI Foundry
    • Azure AI Services / Cognitive Services
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud platform.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Functions.
  • Experience designing and implementing AI-enabled workflows and automation solutions.
  • Understanding of data processing, transformation, and integration patterns.
  • Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs and cloud services.
  • Ability to independently design, develop, test, and deliver production-ready solutions.

Good to Have Skills

  • Experience with AI/LLM-based application development and orchestration.
  • Experience in document processing, information extraction, and classification solutions.
  • Knowledge of workflow orchestration frameworks and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Understanding of data warehousing concepts and structured data models.
  • Experience working on compliance, regulatory, governance, or audit-related solutions.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and observability practices in Azure.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience in Financial Services, Tax, Compliance, or Regulatory domains.
  • Knowledge of Generative AI application development and prompt engineering.
  • Exposure to Responsible AI and AI Governance frameworks.
  • Experience integrating multiple AI models/services within a single business workflow.
  • Familiarity with investment management or tax filing workflows.
  • Exposure to serverless and cloud-native architecture best practices.

Behavioral Requirements

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive deliverables.
  • Hands-on developer who enjoys coding and solving technical problems.
  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote and distributed team environment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Collaborative approach with the ability to work across technical and business teams.
  • Adaptability to evolving requirements and emerging AI technologies.
  • Prioritizes quality, maintainability, and scalability in solution development.
  • Results-oriented with a focus on delivering business value.
  • Self-motivated learner who stays current with Azure AI and Generative AI advancements.
